bearblocker.name: Bearblocker
bearblocker.desc: During your opponent's turn, Set cards in your Spell & Trap Zones cannot be destroyed by card effects. If a Set card(s) in your Spell & Trap Zone is destroyed by an opponent's card effect: This card gains 800 ATK until the end of this turn.

blackwingghiblithesearingwind.name: Blackwing - Ghibli the Searing Wind
blackwingghiblithesearingwind.desc: When your opponent declares a direct attack: You can Special Summon this card from your hand. Once per turn: You can switch the original ATK and DEF of this card, until the end of this turn.

comradeswordsmanoflandstar.name: Comrade Swordsman of Landstar
comradeswordsmanoflandstar.desc: All Warrior-Type monsters you control gain 400 ATK.

detonatedeleter.name: Detonate Deleter
detonatedeleter.desc:
2+ Cyberse monsters
Once per turn, at the start of the Damage Step, when this card battles a face-up monster that is not a Link-3 or higher Link Monster: You can destroy that monster. Once per turn: You can Tribute 1 monster this card points to, then target 1 monster your opponent controls; destroy it.

doubledisruptordragon.name: Double Disruptor Dragon
doubledisruptordragon.desc: You can Tribute this card, then target 2 "Rokket" monsters in your GY with different names; Special Summon them in Defense Position. You can banish this card from your GY; add 1 "Rapid Trigger" or "Heavy Interlock" from your Deck or GY to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Double Disruptor Dragon" once per turn.

firewalldragonsingularity.name: Firewall Dragon Singularity
firewalldragonsingularity.desc:
3+ Effect Monsters
(Quick Effect): You can target cards your opponent controls or in their GY up to the number of different card types (Ritual, Fusion, Synchro, Xyz) you control and in your GY; return them to the hand, also this card gains 500 ATK for each returned card. If a monster this card points to is destroyed by battle, or sent to the GY: You can target 1 Cyberse monster in your GY; Special Summon it. You can only use each effect of "Firewall Dragon Singularity" once per turn.

fuseline.name: Fuse Line
fuseline.desc: While this card is Set: Target 1 card on the field in this card's column; destroy it.

gendotheasceticmonk.name: Gendo the Ascetic Monk
gendotheasceticmonk.desc: Face-up Attack Position monsters on the field cannot activate their effects. This Defense Position card cannot be targeted, or destroyed, by card effects.

gogogogolem.name: Gogogo Golem
gogogogolem.desc: Once per turn, this Defense Position card cannot be destroyed by battle.

hardarmor.name: Hard Armor
hardarmor.desc: A living suit of armor that attacks enemies with a bone-jarring tackle.

heartofclearwater.name: Heart of Clear Water
heartofclearwater.desc: If the equipped monster's ATK is 1300 or higher, this card is destroyed. The monster equipped with this card is not destroyed as a result of battle or by the effect of a card that targets the monster. (Damage calculation is applied normally.)

machineangelabsoluteritual.name: Machine Angel Absolute Ritual
machineangelabsoluteritual.desc: This card can be used to Ritual Summon any "Cyber Angel" Ritual Monster. You must also Tribute monsters from your hand or field and/or shuffle Fairy or Warrior-Type monsters from your Graveyard into the Deck, whose total Levels exactly equal the Level of the Ritual Monster you Ritual Summon.

metalfoessteelen.name: Metalfoes Steelen
metalfoessteelen.desc:
[ Pendulum Effect ] 
Once per turn: You can target 1 other face-up card you control; destroy it, and if you do, Set 1 "Metalfoes" Spell/Trap directly from your Deck.

[ Monster Effect ] 
''Cool iron bodies meet burning metal machines and man/machine combine. Burn up the soul - Metalfoes Fusion!!''

metaphysdaedalus.name: Metaphys Daedalus
metaphysdaedalus.desc: If this card is Special Summoned by the effect of a "Metaphys" monster: You can banish all other face-up Special Summoned monsters on the field. If this card is banished, during the Standby Phase of the next turn: You can shuffle this banished card into the Deck; banish 1 "Metaphys" card from your Deck, except "Metaphys Daedalus".

miscellaneousaurus.name: Miscellaneousaurus
miscellaneousaurus.desc: During either player's Main Phase: You can send this card from your hand to the Graveyard; during this Main Phase, Dinosaur-Type monsters you control are unaffected by your opponent's activated effects. You can banish any number of Dinosaur-Type monsters from your Graveyard, including this card; Special Summon 1 Dinosaur-Type monster from your Deck with a Level equal to the total number of monsters banished to activate this effect, but destroy it during the End Phase. You can only use this effect of "Miscellaneousaurus" once per turn.

morphtroniccord.name: Morphtronic Cord
morphtroniccord.desc: Equip only to a "Morphtronic" monster. Each time the equipped monster's battle position is changed, destroy 1 Spell or Trap Card on the field.

number54lionheart.name: Number 54: Lion Heart
number54lionheart.desc:
3 Level 1 monsters
This face-up Attack Position card cannot be destroyed by battle. When you take battle damage from battles involving this card: Inflict damage to your opponent equal to the amount of battle damage you took. If this card battles an opponent's monster, during damage calculation (in either player's turn): You can detach 1 Xyz Material from this card; your opponent takes any battle damage you would have taken from that battle.

raisemoonstartersqueeze.name: Raise Moon Starter Squeeze
raisemoonstartersqueeze.desc:
(Quick Effect): You can discard this card, then activate 1 of these effects (but you can only use each of these effects of "Raise Moon Starter Squeeze" once per turn);
● You cannot Special Summon from the Extra Deck until the end of the next turn, except Rank 7 Xyz Monsters, also this turn, each time a card(s) is added to your opponent's hand, except by drawing it, immediately draw 1 card.
● Draw 1 card.
You cannot add cards from the Deck to the hand during the Duel you activate this effect, except by drawing them.

rocketarrowexpress.name: Rocket Arrow Express
rocketarrowexpress.desc: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned (from your hand) by controlling no cards, and cannot be Special Summoned by other ways. You cannot conduct your Battle Phase the turn you Special Summon this card. You cannot activate cards or effects, or Set any cards. During each of your Standby Phases, destroy this card unless you send your entire hand to the Graveyard (min.1).

sariofthesilverwingaxe.name: Sari of the Silverwing Axe
sariofthesilverwingaxe.desc: (Quick Effect): You can target 1 face-up monster on the field; equip this card from your hand or field to it. It gains 100 ATK/DEF. You can only use this effect of "Sari of the Silverwing Axe" once per turn.

satellarknightzefrathuban.name: Satellarknight Zefrathuban
satellarknightzefrathuban.desc:
[ Pendulum Effect ] 
You cannot Pendulum Summon monsters, except "tellarknight" and "Zefra" monsters. This effect cannot be negated.

[ Monster Effect ] 
If this card is Normal, Flip, or Pendulum Summoned: You can target 1 other "tellarknight" or "Zefra" card in your Monster Zone or Pendulum Zone, and 1 face-up card your opponent controls; destroy them. You can only use this effect of "Satellarknight Zefrathuban" once per turn.

shamanoftheashenedcity.name: Shaman of the Ashened City
shamanoftheashenedcity.desc: If "Obsidim, the Ashened City" is in the Field Zone, you can Special Summon this card (from your hand). You can only Special Summon "Shaman of the Ashened City" once per turn this way. You can target 3 of your Pyro monsters that are banished and/or in your GY; shuffle them into the Deck, then if you shuffled an "Ashened" monster, you can add 1 "Obsidim, the Ashened City" from your Deck to your hand. You can only use this effect of "Shaman of the Ashened City" once per turn.

spellrecycler.name: Spell Recycler
spellrecycler.desc: When an opponent's monster declares an attack: You can banish this card from your Graveyard, then target 1 Spell Card in your Graveyard; send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard, and if you do, return the target to the bottom of your Deck.

subterrorbehemothphospheroglacier.name: Subterror Behemoth Phospheroglacier
subterrorbehemothphospheroglacier.desc:
FLIP: You can send 1 card from your Deck to the Graveyard. You can only use this effect of "Subterror Behemoth Phospheroglacier" once per turn.
When a face-up monster you control is flipped face-down, if you control no face-up monsters: You can Special Summon this card from your hand in Defense Position. Once per turn: You can change this card to face-down Defense Position.

terribledeal.name: Terrible Deal
terribledeal.desc: Activate only by paying 1000 Life Points when your opponent activates a Spell Card. Your opponent discards 1 random card.

theglitterofraisemoon.name: The Glitter of Raise Moon
theglitterofraisemoon.desc: Special Summon 1 "Raise Moon" Xyz Monster from your Extra Deck, and if you do, attach this card to it, then you can shuffle all "Raise Moon" cards in your GY into the Deck. You can banish this card from your GY; draw 1 card. You can only use this effect of "The Glitter of Raise Moon" once per turn. You cannot add cards from the Deck to the hand during the Duel you activate either of this card's effects, except by drawing them.

theorealize.name: Theorealize
theorealize.desc: Send 1 "Medius the Pure" from your Deck to the GY; look at the top card of your opponent's Deck, and place it on the top or bottom of the Deck. You can banish this card from your GY, then target 1 face-up monster you control and declare 1 Monster Type and 1 Attribute; that monster becomes that Type and Attribute, until the end of your opponent's turn. You can only use each effect of "Theorealize" once per turn.

vendreadcharge.name: Vendread Charge
vendreadcharge.desc: Send 1 Zombie monster from your hand or face-up from your field to the GY; Special Summon 1 "Vendread" monster from your Deck. You can only activate 1 "Vendread Charge" per turn.

wonderxyz.name: Wonder Xyz
wonderxyz.desc: Immediately after this effect resolves, Xyz Summon 1 Xyz Monster using monsters you control as Materials.
